mbm-2201.clue: I took fifty pictures of one lemon.
mbm-2201.quote: A parade went by and I stayed by the lemon tree. Sunlight moved across a lemon in a blue bowl, and for three minutes its shadow was exactly the shape of a fish. I got it on film.

mbm-2202.clue: I leave the clock at home on Sundays.
mbm-2202.quote: A new kid at the park needed ten minutes to decide where her knight went. I watched a whole leaf fall. Her move was so good I needed ten minutes myself.

mbm-2203.clue: I make quilts for odd-shaped things.
mbm-2203.quote: The first was for a piano stool. The next was for a three-legged footrest. When my neighbor offered me a perfectly ordinary blanket commission, I asked if she'd at least like one round corner.

mbm-2204.clue: I juggle over the kitchen mat.
mbm-2204.quote: The bare counter is hard on fallen fruit. The mat gives my practice lemons a fighting chance. When one finally splits, that's my cue to make lemonade.

mbm-2205.clue: I followed the bell ropes upstairs.
mbm-2205.quote: At first all I could hear was the loudest bell. Then the captain stood beside me and hummed my bell's one note. I can pick it out from the street now.

mbm-2206.clue: I draw the clouds from the hangar door.
mbm-2206.quote: I help the flying club roll the glider out on clear Saturdays. The pilot lets me sit up front afterward. Even on the ground, the view from under that canopy is worth the push.

mbm-2207.clue: I paint people waiting for toast.
mbm-2207.quote: My kitchen series started when the toaster broke. I painted my housemate in his bathrobe, glaring at it. He says it's the only portrait that gets his eyebrows right.

mbm-2208.clue: I practice falling before anything else.
mbm-2208.quote: The judo mat makes a different sound when I relax into a breakfall. Our instructor knows with her eyes shut. I like starting each session with something I can hear improve.

mbm-2209.clue: I work one color past closing time.
mbm-2209.quote: There's a florist who lets me paint her buckets after the shutters come down. Last week the flowers were sold out. I did the dents in the buckets. She framed that one.

mbm-2210.clue: I served arepas from our record player.
mbm-2210.quote: The griddle was ready before we'd cleared the breakfast table. My sister put a serving plate on the old turntable, completely unplugged, and spun our arepas past the waiting hands. Her slowest record ever.

mbm-2211.clue: I keep the cup that leans left.
mbm-2211.quote: When I was learning to throw, I made a mug that tilts toward whoever's holding it. My friend set it on my desk with a biscuit in it. I finally understood what it was for.

mbm-2212.clue: I paint my fans partly closed.
mbm-2212.quote: I like the little surprise when the folds open. My latest fan is plain black until you snap it wide and seven white herons step out of the reeds.

mbm-2213.clue: I packed a campsite for two shadows.
mbm-2213.quote: I pitched the tent under a tree that forks right at the base. At sunset my one tent had two tall leafy shadows and looked like a castle. I stayed an extra night.

mbm-2214.clue: I learned to quilt from a checkerboard.
mbm-2214.quote: I cut all the dark squares first and ran out of plain white. The flour-sack scraps had tiny cherries on them. Now every red checker looks like it's sitting down to lunch.

mbm-2215.clue: I kept my first skydiving shoelaces.
mbm-2215.quote: My instructor double-knotted them before we boarded. I put on the same shoes for every jump until the soles went. The laces live on my gear bag now, one red knot on each handle.

mbm-2216.clue: I look for the back of the monument.
mbm-2216.quote: The front's been in a thousand snapshots. Walk round the back and you might see who laid the stones or where the pigeons sleep. Once I found a man painting a perfect miniature of the back.

mbm-2217.clue: I reserve the square of sun by the wall.
mbm-2217.quote: My borrowed courtyard only gets direct light for a little while. I lay my towel where the light will be. Last Sunday a cat booked half the square ahead of me.

mbm-2218.clue: I save one episode for pancake night.
mbm-2218.quote: My mystery show starts when the last pancake leaves the pan. I sit cross-legged in plaid pajamas and announce the culprit. Last week I accused a man who wasn't even in the episode.

mbm-2219.clue: I ask which exhibit arrived last.
mbm-2219.quote: At the transport museum it was a battered conductor's stool. The guide had ridden his tram as a girl. We spent an hour with that little green stool and never reached the buses.

mbm-2220.clue: I play golf for a particular sound.
mbm-2220.quote: A proper long putt has two endings. There's the click off the face, then time enough to think you've missed, then the tiny rattle in the cup. I could listen to that all afternoon.

mbm-2221.clue: I remember the foxtrot by our curtains.
mbm-2221.quote: Our studio curtains have faded stripes. Every fourth slow step used to bring us level with the green one. The owner replaced them and my feet kept finding green anyway.

mbm-2222.clue: I can tell our raft by its patch.
mbm-2222.quote: The repair is shaped like an eggplant. The first guiding crew painted a stem on it. We greet every returning raft like a celebrity, but only ours gets called Aubergine.

mbm-2223.clue: I quilt the empty space first.
mbm-2223.quote: My sketchbook was full of star patterns. I spent weeks planning the gaps between them, and my friend said she'd never seen such a lovely flock of geese. I used her title.

mbm-2224.clue: I sleep near the camp kettle.
mbm-2224.quote: My friend wakes first and I can tell when the lid starts rattling. Best alarm in the world. On our last trip I poked my head out to find a squirrel sitting right beside it.

mbm-2225.clue: I kayak as far as the green gate.
mbm-2225.quote: The little boathouse used to be yellow. I paddled straight past it the first week they painted it green. The extra bend gave me a heron and a new turnaround point.
